rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the Court on a narrow vacate-and-remand path grounded in Rule 23(b)(3) predominance/manageability and administrable class definition requirements, while reiterating TransUnion’s bar on damages for uninjured members. Separate writings are most likely from Sotomayor (dissent emphasizing TransUnion’s timing reservation) and from Thomas/Gorsuch/Alito (to press a more explicitly constitutional/Rules Enabling Act framing).
